speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: The president of the United States has repeatedly suggested using nuclear weapons in the war against Iran. Now, if you were to pose this question to the White House press office, they would say the president has never suggested using nukes, but of course that's not true. Because in statement after statement, posted on the internet, on True Social, the president has threatened the total destruction of Iran, of the civilization itself. And of course you can't achieve that with any conventional weapon. There's only one way to achieve that, the total destruction of a civilization, and that's with nuclear weapons. And so we should consider that a real possibility.
